Virender Sehwag to host reality show 'Rise and Fall'

Former Indian cricketer Virender Sehwag will host the reality show 'Rise and Fall'. Sehwag will reportedly use his 20 years of experience from his cricket career in the show. He stated that he would give contestants "one or two chances, then I won't spare them."
